testInfo.description: German national wallet upstream iOS app; local simulator conformance run
testInfo.summary: Sends a redirect_uri parameter in the authorization request alongside response_uri when using direct_post. As per https://openid.net/specs/openid-4-verifiable-presentations-1_0.html#section-8.2 'If the redirect_uri Authorization Request parameter is present when the Response Mode is direct_post, the Wallet MUST return an invalid_request Authorization Response error.' The wallet should reject this request and display an error, a screenshot of which must be uploaded.
